items.html:
Calo (Jialu) An is a director, animator, and illustrator from China, and currently based in Atlanta. She received her masters degree in Animation at Savannah College of Art and Design in 2022.  

​

Calo loves to explore from variety of visual language and define a unique art style for different animations. She believes that an exceptional art style could gives the story more potential.

​

During her spare time, she likes to spend times with her friends. She is also a dog mom, and used to do dog rescue. Things are cute but with a little weird is her favourite type.

​

"Animation is a key to the dream world. I believe that the reliable performance of animation will break the boundary of reality and fantasy, and bring people an unprecedented experience. With the passion of taking people to my fantasy world, I have been pursuing persuasive acting in animation as an animator for the past three years. The passion of making enjoyable and relatable animation drives me to keep exploring both the technical and conceptual side of my career. During my undergraduate study in film, this kind of time-based visual art gave me enthusiasm, and it made me realize that my favorite form of visual art is animation. Unlike film, animation gives me more freedom to let my imagination come true. When I mimic myself through different characters with different personalities, the colors of those souls bring me uncountable joy and empathy. I hope to deliver this idea to more people through my works, regardless of language, environment, or culture. In the creative process, it is my belief to convey the concept and the spirit of entertainment."

​

--Calo An

Bob, the main character is a fish tank head guy who lives in a big slanted city. He is a regular, even dull employee. Like most people in this city, he has almost the same daily routine. He is introverted and timid, cowardly, and afraid of things as if everything is not going his way. His work is clean up the dead fish on the street, but everything changes after he found an alive one.
Der, the fish's name. He is an abandoned little fish, because no one cares about fish's life in the city, except Bob. So he is puny and helpless, sensitive but still full of curious to the world.

items.title: FishBob
items.description: This is an animated 2D short film I have directed for my graduation thesis at Savannah College of Arts and Design. The concept was inspired by my trip to San Francisco. As a director and animation supervisor, the story was created by multiple talented artists from SCAD.

items.description: The Self-portrait is an individual project that shows the whole progress of the most inspiring moment of myself. The main goal of the short is creating a loop within 15 seconds.

items.title: The Workout
items.description: This is an individual animation project that represent the sense of time illusion when people workout. The whole animation has been done in two weeks. And I am responsible for all works in this project.

The little girl, Rain, once finds her tooth fall off. She has no idea what is going on with the tooth and she afraids. Rain asks the grandma, however, she needs to find the ultimate answer by herself.

Rain-she is a 7 years old girl with a little "OCT" in her personality. She likes organize everything in order. Rain is borned in a countryside and her best friends are the gooses, dogs, cats, chicks, and her grandmother. She enjoys the nature and she always can find rhythmic in there.

​

Junhui-the grandma is a 79 years old lady. She experiences a lot in her past life times. Grandma talks slow and she tends to do everything randomly. She loves everything about life and she is full of peaceful and grateful. Her granddaughter, Rain, makes the best accompany to her. Junhui likes to tells some old stories to Rain.

An alcoholic assassin from ancient China gets a secret mission to kill the emperor, but when he wakes up after a drunk night, he finds himself lays next to his dead body in the emperor’s coffin chamber. Then a group of tomb break into the coffin chamber, the assassin decides to go adventure with them and keeps looking for the truth of his own death in the modern period.
